newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian bonds, futures closing report.
newsitem.headline: Italian bonds, futures closing report.

text.p: Italian debt markets returned to positive territory by the close helped by interest at the short end of the market and encouraged by the strengthening lira.

The currency bustled back towards its 990 central parity against the mark in the exchange rate mechanism, prompting talk that if this kept up the Bank of Italy might find room to cut interest rates once April inflation data had been released.
The lira was quoted at 991.25/1.65 per mark by 1545 GMT, up from 993 seen in late European trade on Wednesday.
The June Btp future on LIFFE was 32 basis points up at 124.74 having just forced its way through 124.65 resistance.
